author: National Geographic
description:
This Halloween Season, go back in history to learn about one of the darkest times in Human history in this Witches: Truth Behind the Trials MEGA episode from National Geographic. In these three full episodes, travel to England, Germany, and Sweden to discover the events leading to the witch hysteria and the cruel crusades taken up against mainly women. 

England: The Witchfinders' Cruel Crusade - 00:00 
Two self-appointed witch-hunters investigate and torture so-called witches in exchange for money during the turmoil of England’s Civil War. 

Germany: The Witch Hunts Begin - 44:01 
Why are witches mainly women and why were they hunted and tried for an impossible crime? The story of Europe’s early witch trials in Trier. 

Sweden: The Legend of Blåkulla - 1:28:02
An event in Sweden in the 17th Century creates a hysteria driven by terrified parents convinced witches are abducting their children. 

Witches: Truth Behind the Trials | S1
